test_title: PYST 6: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 06 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
A & B means 'A is the son of B'

A # B means 'A is the sister of B'

A @ B means 'A is the brother of B'

A % B means 'A is the father of B'

A - B means 'A is the daughter of B'

A * B means 'A is the wife of B'

If C # D @ E % Z & L # M - N * P, then how is E related to L?
solution:
From the given information the equation becomes:

C # D @ E % Z & L # M - N * P,

C is the sister of D, D is the brother of E, E is the father of Z, Z is the son of L, L is the sister of M, M is the daughter of N, N is the wife of P.
